extractionMethod: Scanned PDF rendered with CoreGraphics at 144 dpi; Tesseract OCR; visual corrections and format restoration against original page renders.
formattingNotes: Retained original wording, source advertisements, notes bullets, italics and underlining. Completion blanks use five underscores. Line wrapping follows responsive browser layout; paragraph breaks are retained.
knownSourceDefects: Module 2 Q10 chart clips the beginning of its axis-description text in the original source. Crop preserves everything visible; nothing was redrawn.
skillLabels: Assigned for the existing teacher analysis; labels are not an official key.
